WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS num_films
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  r.rating,
  r.ratio,
  r.num_films,
  r.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS ratio_minus_average
FROM rating_stats r
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
ORDER BY r.rating
